lines.intro: In this lesson, you'll add a coin to catch, and keep score.
lines.recap: The player moves with the arrow keys, its blocks folded up here. {coin}And there's a new sprite: define sprite coin, still empty.
lines.create: First, from {click}Program, drag {grab}create sprite under create sprite player. {pick}Pick coin in its list, {x}and put it at 60, 60.
lines.look: From {click}Looks, drag {grab}look like a circle into define sprite coin. Make it {size}size 14, and {colour}yellow.
lines.random: From {click}Motion, {grab}go to a random place puts the coin somewhere new.
lines.loop: Then, from {click}Control, a forever loop, {if}with an if inside it.
lines.touching: From {click}Sensing, {grab}touching sprite goes in the if. {player}Pick player in its list.
lines.score: When the player touches the coin, from {click}Variables, {grab}change score by 1.
lines.jump: And from {click}Motion, {grab}go to a random place again, so the coin jumps somewhere else.
lines.show: Last, show the score. From {click}Control, {forever}a forever at the end of when the game starts, {show}with show variable score inside it.
lines.run: Press {click}Run, {game}click the game, and go and catch the coin.
lines.playing: Every coin you catch adds one to your score, and the coin jumps away.
lines.code: In the code, {coin}the coin is a PROCESS of its own, and {touch}touching became a collision test.
lines.outro: Nice! {next}In lesson four, you'll dodge an enemy that bounces around.
